title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payments
jd_text:
Senior Backend Engineer - Payments (Bengaluru, hybrid)

We run the money movement layer for a B2B payments platform processing ~2M transactions a day. You will own the ledger and settlement services end to end.

What we need
- Must have 4+ years building production backend services in Python
- Must have hands-on experience designing and operating REST APIs at scale, ideally with FastAPI, Flask or Django
- Must have worked with relational databases, including schema design, indexing and query tuning on PostgreSQL
- Must have experience with payments, ledgers, reconciliation or another financial domain where correctness matters
- Must be comfortable owning production systems: on-call, incident response, observability and alerting
- Strong written communication, able to write design documents that other teams review
- Experience with event-driven systems such as Kafka, SQS or RabbitMQ
- Nice to have: Kubernetes and container orchestration in production
- Nice to have: experience mentoring junior engineers or leading a small team
- Nice to have: exposure to compliance-heavy environments such as PCI DSS or RBI regulations
